datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: The Apify dataset ID from the scraper run to deduplicate. If empty, will attempt to read from webhook payload (resource.defaultDatasetId).

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (Recommended)
slackWebhookUrl.description: Optional Slack Incoming Webhook URL. If provided, sends a rich Block Kit formatted digest directly to your Slack channel.

sourceLabel.title: Search Keyword / Source Label
sourceLabel.description: Tag or keyword identifying the source run (e.g., 'AI ML Engineer - Pune').

excludeTitleRegex.title: Exclude Senior/Lead Roles Regex
excludeTitleRegex.description: Regex pattern to identify and filter out experienced roles (case-insensitive).

requiredExperienceMaxYears.title: Max Experience (Years)
requiredExperienceMaxYears.description: Max experience in years if parsed from job description/title (default 2).

storeName.title: Key-Value Store Name
storeName.description: Named Key-Value Store used across all tasks to maintain persistent deduplication state.
